title: Traveler's Rest | KEY.co
description_expanded: Tucked within a gated enclave in Inlet Beach, this remarkable four-story retreat blends timeless coastal design with expansive indoor and outdoor living spaces. Thoughtfully crafted with reclaimed heart pine floors, Pecky cypress ceilings, and refined architectural details, the home offers an atmosphere of warmth and sophistication. The open main living area flows seamlessly into a chef’s kitchen equipped with premium appliances, generous dining space, and inviting gathering areas designed for memorable moments together. Multiple porches and balconies invite natural light and coastal breezes, while the observation tower and rooftop terrace provide sweeping Gulf views that create a stunning backdrop for sunrise coffee or sunset relaxation. The outdoor experience is designed for both connection and relaxation, centered around a private pool with a tranquil water feature, a summer kitchen for open-air dining, and a firepit perfect for evening conversations under the stars. A charming carriage house offers additional privacy with its own kitchen and living space, ideal for extended family or guests. Elevator access, multiple laundry areas, and spacious bedroom suites with private baths ensure comfort and convenience for larger groups. Located just steps from the beach and moments from Rosemary Beach and 30Avenue, this beautifully designed coastal estate offers a peaceful setting for unforgettable gatherings along the Gulf.
